steps: Existing three registered unit files, existing actual-tuner cache controls, and varied-token/canary lifetime probe including exceptional exits and a hoisted-context negative control.

One independent cold process per legacy/scoped arm, then four fresh warm processes in legacy/scoped/scoped/legacy order. Same source, image, model, hardware and serving shapes. Cold runs omit performance; warm runs measure the existing six shapes. Verify cache bytes, zero warm/capture/serving profiling, restored legacy identity, changed-input graph behavior, and record original parity checks without dropping discrepancies.

Unchanged registered TestModeloptFP8.test_gsm8k with opt-in off/on and separate fresh caches. Existing >0.70 floor, paired answers and capture/replay observation. Preserve original cross-tactic parity failures and record new differences independently.
Publish the refreshed production head and separate research evidence; mark ready only if qualification supports review, with limitations explicit. Trigger applicable SGLang CI on that head.
performance_scope: Bounded warm ABBA latency comparison, no full serving-throughput claim. Investigate any consistent regression above 3%; smaller measurements remain descriptive, not proof of equivalence.
accuracy_scope: Both arms must pass the existing floor; a lower scoped paired score still merits inspection. No weakened parity tolerances or selection of favorable restarts.
